title: 교육감 소속 지방공무원 인사교류 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Preparation and Notification of Personnel Exchange Plans)
(1) When conducting personnel exchanges pursuant to Article 30-2 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Education shall prepare personnel exchange plans based on standards for personnel exchanges determined by the Council, notify the relevant superintendents of education of the plans, and recommend their implementation. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) Within 30 days after receiving notification of a personnel exchange plan under paragraph (1), a superintendent of education shall consult the relevant superintendents of education, implement appointment procedures for public officials subject to the personnel exchange, and notify the Minister of Education of the measures implemented. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
